newsitems.title: Update 12.2.0
newsitems.author: Embark | Marshall
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/50263519bafc8497d6489a6fd4a6c8560540514e.png"][/img]This week we’re bringing a refreshed Store, more info about TGM26 and some balance changes. You still have a few more days to redeem any tickets you may have left before the Frights Galore Event closes! We have more coming, so stay tuned.. and watch your head.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]STORE [/b]| GOAT EXPECTATIONS SET[/h2][previewyoutube="oDImrIiir9k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you’re going to butt heads with the competition, it’s better to do so in style with the [b]Goat Expectations Set! [/b]For our Contestants feeling some nostalgia, good news, the [b]Dual Shockers Set[/b] is here to fulfill your pixelated needs.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]TGM26 [/b]| COSPLAY SHOWCASE[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/0ea1c041cecbed10d6d58ebca3db53a6d9480a71.png"][/img]The Grand Major 2026 is coming up, and all Contestants are invited! We have seen your passion, online and in person last year, so this time we’re hosting our very own[b] THE FINALS Cosplay Showcase at DreamHack Stockholm. [/b][/p][p]Show off your costume, step on the stage and impress the Sponsors.  No vault to steal, no cashout to defend.[b] Just you, your creation and the audience[/b]. Impress them and you could win some merch! Every Contestant participating in the event will also receive a participation Diploma and Multibucks.[/p][p]
All the details and information on how to sign up can be found [url="https://greyhound-chiton-ne6t.squarespace.com/patchnotes/tgm26-cosplay"][b]HERE[/b][/url][/p][p][i]See you in Stockholm![/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]GAME UPDATE [/b]| BALANCE CHANGES
[/h2][h3][b]DEV NOTE[/b][/h3][p]We’re making some tweaks today to some of the Medium’s automatic and semi-auto weapons. These are aimed at two problems: Improving the Medium’s chances when dueling versus the now 175 HP Lights, and providing Mediums with more viable tracking aim options in their weapon pool. [/p][p]While the argument could be made that some of this could also be achieved by nerfing Light weapons, Light still lags slightly among the archetypes across many skill tiers and modes, so we’d rather target this match-up specifically. Despite Heavy losing some HP in 12.0, it appears to have coped just fine with that change, in large part because of the wide array of defensive tools it has to protect itself against a more powerful Light. We feel these buffs to Medium will be similarly handled by the Heavy, but will allow Medium versus Light match-ups to be a little more balanced. [/p][p]Among the changes, we’re shifting the FCAR back towards the direction it had earlier in the life of the game, as a slower firing but more punchy weapon, differentiating it slightly further from the AKM. [/p][p]It’s worth noting that these changes are ‘tweakable’ changes, changes we can deploy without needing to patch the game client because they do not require new code or content such as audio, animations or VFX. In 12.3 an additional small round of balance changes will also come to the game that are done in support of this set of changes, but we didn’t feel we should wait for those before making these adjustments. 
[/p][h3][b]Weapon[/b][/h3][p][b]AKM[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased ammo count from 34 to 36[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chimera-XB[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 47 to 48[/p][/*][*][p]Increased rate of fire from 260 RPM to 280 RPM[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]FCAR[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased damage from 23 to 25[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased rate of fire from 530 RPM to 500 RPM[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased ammo count from 25 to 20[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Update 11.12.0
newsitems.author: CM | Marshall
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/28eaf061f5adca06d9756292d94952f014305771.png"][/img][/p][p][b]ONE SHOWDOWN. ONE WINNER[/b][/p][p]This week, ENGIMO and COMETA are battling for fans! We’ve also turned our end-of-season XP event on, refreshed the Store, brought some new Twitch drops your way alongside some bug-fixes. Let’s unpack this week’s update and see what’s new![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]EVENT [/b]| SPONSOR SHOWDOWN[/h2][previewyoutube="amJxp7XZqL8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Contestants, it is time to fill in the paperwork and choose which Sponsor you will represent in the Arena in a battle for fans! [b]Sponsors are looking for Contestants ready to put on a show[/b] and earn the support from fans in a race to the top of the leaderboard.[/p][p]Play any mode, impress everyone, and earn fans. [b]There will only be one winner![/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]EVENT [/b]| APOGEE XP[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/d516ce691ef4ebc2f2a36a392035d2780eb946a0.png"][/img][/p][p]From today until the end of Season 11, [b]we’re boosting your XP and fans earnings!
[/b]Earn [b]up to 200% XP[/b] from Daily Contracts and [b]up to 150% XP and fans[/b] from gameplay, perfect to complete any missing tiers in your Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]STORE [/b]| VACUUM GRUNT SET[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/6dd1f4df4dda5efcdcf49f23f32c13f5e8643a33.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Geared up, it’s time to pick another shift.

[/b]Where you’re going, your radio will be your only point of contact with the base of operations, so don’t lose it. This week is loaded with all the equipment you need to get your mission completed successfully; get it done! 
[i]Over and out.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]TWITCH [/b]| RAKING COINS[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849803/e4a127805ddb268d6e883ced23c178c55858683e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Coins and leaves are falling into the Arena, perfect time to pick up a new rake.
[b]Watch anyone playing THE FINALS with Drops Enabled[/b] and earn some nice freebies to celebrate the return of Fall![/p][list][*][p]Watch [b]1 hour[/b] to get the [b]Forage Fortune Charm[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Watch [b]2 hours[/b] to get the [b]Seed Money Earrings[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Watch [b]4 hours[/b] to get the [b]Havoc Raker Sledgehammer[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Available now until October 15th, 2026. Terms and conditions on [u][url="http://twitch.tv/"]twitch.tv[/url][/u][/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]GAME UPDATE [/b]| CONTENT AND BUG FIXES
[/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Tutorial where voice-over could get stuck after completing the Reinforce the Cashout objective.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Cosmetics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed decal issues for "Engimo Signal Flux" Minigun and Pike skin[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the FAMAS Corelight Engine and SciFiRetro Ultimate skins so the glass shroud is transparent on Medium and Low graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced clipping on the rotating part of the “Hypnotic Method” skin for the CL-40[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Social[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where party voice chat could stop working on consoles after suspending and resuming the game[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a rare issue that could end matches when firing at moving platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hang that could occur around the podium scenes or at the end of round if DLSS Frame Generation is enabled[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated spectator team colors to be colorblind-safe in Private Matches and Colorblind Mode for improved visibility[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where Weapons could clip into walls when standing close to surfaces or after watching another Contestant climb a ladder[/p][/*][/list]
